all.method: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, n, (draws, n)); whole seeds in seedbook order; percentile 95% (numpy linear interpolation); one index matrix for every statistic on this seed set

fine.method: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, n, (draws, n)); whole seeds in seedbook order; percentile 95% (numpy linear interpolation); one index matrix for every statistic on this seed set

estimand: F* = 1 - mean(K1)/mean(K0) over backgrounds (original workflow, p -> 0, fixed horizon).

gate.definition: Gate comparison of one simulated record ``row`` with the archived ``extended`` row.

limitations: These are fixed-horizon p -> 0 limits. They give no finite-p error bound, and the finite-p reversal remains untested (O-3).
Transition-defined compliance assumes the stationary Markov law and the model's exit/entry opportunity rule.

prediction_1_crossing.criterion: holds iff the interpolated root e* (lowest-e sign change of D on the grid) lies in [.91, .935]
prediction_1_crossing.grid_note: Every e at which both rho=0 and rho=.5 rows at h .90->.95 are computed on all inference seeds (archived, crossing and, under the full plan, fine-grid rows; duplicates are bitwise equal and the archived/crossing row is used).
prediction_1_crossing.statement: Crossing. The ICU crossing e* is the root of D(e) = F*(rho=.5) - F*(rho=0) at h .90->.95, found by linear interpolation between adjacent grid e values. It lies in [.91, .935]. (Isolated k=2 root: .9235.)

prediction_2_completion_ranges.criterion: holds iff every component holds (point estimates); bootstrap intervals and sign fractions are reported
prediction_2_completion_ranges.statement: Completion ranges. At e = .8, D < 0 for .60->.70 and .70->.80 (isolated -3.5 and -2.4 pp), and D > 0 for .80->.90 (isolated +1.2 pp). At e = 1, D < 0 in every range.

prediction_3_transition_policy.statement: Transition-defined policy. At e = 1, |F*(rho=.5) - F*(rho=0)| < 5 pp, against 21.5 pp under the per-boundary policy. (Isolated k=2: exactly 0.)

prediction_4_renewal_comparator.criterion: holds iff max over the 132 fine-grid rows of |F_geo - F*| <= .035
prediction_4_renewal_comparator.statement: Renewal comparator. Over the 132-row fine grid, the largest |F_geo - F*| is at most 3.5 pp. F_geo is the closed form defined in the manuscript (supplement S4.2); its largest deviation on the 22 archived rows was 2.78 pp.

code_check.note: The same feasible-set loop reproduces the round-1 isolated-bridge grid widths exactly (the code check) and the round-1 approximate ICU widths exactly; the isolated grid widths agree with the certified continuous widths to < 1e-6 pp.

secondary_exact_icu_projection.label: Projection of saved measurements (comparison with the approximate values is labelled as a comparison); no new measurement or coverage claim.
secondary_exact_icu_projection.method: Feasible sets as in supplement S11 / round1 section 9 (81 e x 61 rho, n = 8,000 per assay); surface = bilinear interpolation of the computed ICU F* on the fine grid; domain rho <= .95, e >= .5; sets with any evaluated feasible point outside the domain are counted (out_of_domain) and excluded, never extrapolated.

all.note: archived, crossing, completion and transition pairs
